$comment: Keys an agent declares twice, as its canonical key and as an older spelling it still reads only as a fallback, instead of declaring the older one as an alias of the canonical key. The generator folds each `alias` into `key` as a deprecated alias, so the SDK offers only the canonical key. It fails when the agent data no longer declares both keys: remove the entry once the agent declares the alias itself. See docs/offer-contracts.md.
